root.reaches_machines_by: ssh to Hetzner only; home-network machines only through the Agent Bus on Hetzner, which they connect out to
root.note: No competing root on any machine. Root coordinates across machines; it never opens a connection into a home machine.

rule: Work runs on available machines. Hetzner is available when its ssh probe answers. A home-network machine (no inbound connections) is available when it has checked in on the Agent Bus within the freshness window; it receives work as bus messages it pulls and talks to other machines through the bus. Root coordinates.

role_authority.auth: mTLS client certificate scoped to enrolled actors

win35_adapter.auth: mTLS client certificate plus allowlisted device/project scope

bus.checkin_signals: role authority agents.seen and live role leases (mTLS, port 8801); bus messages sent and ack/accept/complete of messages addressed to the machine's identities. Identity registration alone does not count (Hetzner-side enrollment registers identities on a home machine's behalf).
